evidence.claim: Order-book imbalance is a documented short-horizon signal in equity microstructure literature; transfer to prediction markets is UNVERIFIED here.

failure_mode: Displayed depth can be pulled (stale quotes) or is genuinely uninformative; imbalance can also mean the heavy side is about to be hit through. The forward ledger is the test — similarity to order-flow imbalance in equity microstructure is explicitly NOT assumed to transfer.
name: Depth Imbalance Diver
rule: On a universe market with displayed bid depth on BOTH sides, compute imbalance = (YES depth - NO depth) / (YES depth + NO depth). If |imbalance| >= 0.40, buy the heavier side at its ask (limit ask + 2c), sizing 15% of cash, and hold to settlement.
why: Visible resting liquidity is a cheap public signal: persistent one-sided depth can reflect informed flow or stale quotes. The rule logs the full level list with every fill so the claim can be audited bar by bar.
